name: Ayukawa Hitomi
source:
A doctor who wears a qipao. Opposed to both the miko uniform and the nun uniform, she proposed that the nurses should wear the "China nurse" uniform. As none of the nurses actually wear her proposed uniform, she wears it herself.

[from Wikipedia]
